issue_context.title: LegacyCursor's cursormiddle expands
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** As stated on [wiki](https://osu.ppy.sh/help/wiki/Skinning/Interface#cursor):

> This element (cursormiddle) does not rotate nor expand (on click).

With `CursorExpand` on in lazer however, this element expands, which is not intended behavior.

**osu!lazer version:** Commit `7d6cd72`

**Logs:** Not required

review_comments:
I am not very sure how to document this property. Would like to say "The part of a cursor that expands on mouse down" to clarify its primary purpose, but this seems to repeat variable name.

Might be good to rename it to "Dynamic" to cover the usage in `LegacyCursor`.
